phases.name: Project Foundation
phases.gate: Scaffold and initial migration verified; safe repeatable seed, reproducible source/environment setup and API lifecycle ready.

phases.name: Competition and Contestant Management
phases.gate: Protected management and public browsing enforce competition membership, lifecycle and voting windows.

phases.name: Email Verification
phases.gate: Deliver, verify, expire, throttle and consume email verification securely; voter verification UI works.

phases.name: Payments and Vote Allocation
phases.gate: Server-owned checkout, authenticated verified payments, atomic idempotent votes and reconciliation/refund handling pass.

phases.name: Admin Dashboard
phases.gate: Protected management/reporting and auditable operator actions work.

phases.name: Testing, CI/CD and Deployment
phases.gate: Critical tests pass in CI; staging, database restore, monitoring and launch rehearsal pass.

labels.name: area:payments
labels.description: Paystack, payment lifecycle and vote accounting

issues.title: Create workspace, Next.js starter and Express health scaffold
issues.description: Record the narrowly scoped scaffold already present locally. This does not certify a production build or any voting feature.
acceptance: Root npm workspaces contain apps/web and apps/api with development commands.
Express health route returns HTTP 200 and status ok.
API TypeScript check and frontend lint pass.
evidence: package.json defines both workspaces and dev:web/dev:api. apps/web/src/app/page.tsx is the generated starter; apps/api/src/app.ts exposes /api/v1/health.
2026-10-21: tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit and npm run lint --workspace=apps/web exited 0; a live ephemeral-port health request returned 200/status ok.
Local source is untracked and GitHub is empty. Publishing the source is F04.

issues.title: Define initial Prisma models and verify initial database migration
issues.description: Record the existing initial data model and applied migration. Domain and payment invariants remain separate implementation work.
acceptance: Eight domain models and CompetitionStatus/PaymentStatus enums exist in schema and initial SQL migration.
Prisma validates the schema and migration history is current in the configured database.
A read-only live database comparison finds no difference from the Prisma data model.
evidence: prisma/schema.prisma and prisma/migrations/20261021044148_init/migration.sql define Competition, Contestant, VotePackage, ContactVerification, Payment, VoteAllocation, AdminUser and AuditLog.
2026-10-21: prisma validate exited 0. prisma migrate status exited 0: one migration, database schema up to date.
2026-10-21: prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datasource prisma/schema.prisma --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --exit-code exited 0: No difference detected.
Checks establish the configured database state at review time, not production readiness, backups or restored data reliability.

issues.title: Implement repeatable development database seeding
issues.description: Make database seeding the next development task. Create fictional fixtures for competition and voter development without generating paid votes or unsafe credentials.
acceptance: Add prisma/seed.ts and configure the Prisma 6.19 seed command with an explicitly resolvable TypeScript runner.
Seed a fictional competition, contestants and positive integer-kobo vote packages with stable identifiers; a second run produces no duplicates.
Require an explicit development/test database target and refuse production or ambiguous targets. Perform no resets or truncation.
Use no real contacts, real payments, allocated votes or hard-coded admin passwords. Document commands and prerequisites.
On an isolated development database run twice and verify counts, relations, zero vote totals and clean disconnection on success/failure.
evidence: No seed file or migrations.seed setting exists in the reviewed tree. F02 migration prerequisites are verified.

issues.title: Publish a reproducible source and environment baseline
issues.description: Local Git has no commits or remote; the existing public GitHub repository is empty. Establish a safe source baseline and reproducible setup.
acceptance: Review ignore rules for .env variants, dependencies, build outputs and local artifacts; add a secret-free .env.example and root README.
Document npm ci, app commands, Prisma generation, migration/seed commands, runtime requirements and runtime versus migration database URLs.
Review staged content for secrets, make the initial commit, configure the intended remote and push a default branch.
Verify a clean checkout installs, typechecks, lints and builds both apps; record/fix Next.js font or network requirements.
Document web -> Express -> Prisma/PostgreSQL ownership; browser code receives no database or payment provider secret.
evidence: git log reports no commits; git remote -v is empty; all application files are untracked. GitHub reports ebukanathan/TalentHunt is public and empty.
The project-management setup itself will not commit, push or change repository visibility.

issues.title: Add API configuration, Prisma lifecycle and safe error handling
issues.description: Build a small service foundation before feature routes. Current middleware is Helmet, localhost CORS and JSON parsing, with a health endpoint only.
acceptance: Share one appropriately managed Prisma client, validate server configuration and implement graceful HTTP/database shutdown.
Add validated input, consistent sanitized errors, request IDs, structured logs and meaningful readiness checks.
Configure explicit frontend origins and body limits; reserve a webhook route that retains original signed bytes before general JSON parsing.
Verify bad input, missing configuration, unavailable database and shutdown without exposing secrets or unnecessary personal data.

issues.title: Implement protected competition lifecycle and vote-package management
issues.description: Implement authorized competition/package services. Existing schema fields do not establish business rules or working endpoints.
acceptance: Validate DRAFT/SCHEDULED/OPEN/CLOSED/COMPLETED transitions, UTC windows and opens-before-closes.
Enforce positive integer priceKobo/voteCount, supported currency, package ownership and slug uniqueness; add appropriate database checks via reviewed migrations.
Authorize all mutations, write audit events and preserve existing payment snapshots after package edits.
Test forbidden access, invalid transitions, duplicate slugs, negative values, closed windows and deactivation.

issues.title: Implement protected contestant management and cross-competition guards
issues.description: Provide contestant editing and deactivation with integrity rules preventing attribution to another competition.
acceptance: Implement protected create/update/list/deactivate endpoints with pagination and validated contestant fields/image URLs.
Enforce contestant number/slug uniqueness per competition and consistent competition membership of contestant, package and payment; state which invariants the database enforces.
Preserve referenced history and reject edits that corrupt historical attribution.
Test cross-competition references, inactive contestants, duplicate identifiers and unauthorized mutation.

issues.title: Build public competition pages, contestant profiles and leaderboard
issues.description: Replace the generated homepage with read-only public competition and contestant views.
acceptance: Show competition state, contestants, profiles and active packages with loading, empty, not-found and error states.
Define tie ordering/leaderboard visibility and pagination; serialize BigInt vote totals safely as decimal strings.
Show eligibility/voting-window state; enforce it again at checkout on the server.
Check responsive layout and keyboard access; public responses expose no voter contact, payment details or admin-only fields.

issues.title: Send verification codes with expiry and abuse controls
issues.description: Implement transactional email delivery and code issuance. ContactVerification currently provides a data model only.
acceptance: Choose/configure an email provider and development fake with documented environment variables.
Generate cryptographically random codes, store only a keyed hash suitable for short OTPs, and enforce expiry, resend cooldown and per-address/per-IP limits.
Invalidate superseded challenges, give generic responses and exclude codes/personal data from logs.
Test provider failure, resend/concurrent issuance, throttling and expiry.

issues.title: Verify email and atomically consume checkout authorization
issues.description: Bind verification to a short-lived single-use checkout authorization. Nullable Payment.verificationId does not enforce verified email.
acceptance: Enforce expiration/attempt limits and safe hash comparison; return a scoped opaque authorization after successful verification.
Bind authorization to server-side normalized email/challenge state; client fields cannot assert verification.
Consume authorization atomically with local payment creation and document retry behavior after provider initialization failures.
Test brute force, replay, expired codes, email substitution and concurrent consumption.

issues.title: Build the voter email-verification flow
issues.description: Add email and code entry before checkout while retaining the selected contestant/package.
acceptance: Support code entry, resend countdown, expiry, edit-email and recoverable delivery errors.
Use accessible labels/focus and display server errors; client validation never substitutes for server verification.
Retain voting selection without exposing authorization in URLs/analytics; recover gracefully from expired authorization.

issues.title: Initialize Paystack checkout using server-owned payment snapshots
issues.description: Create local pending payments and hosted checkout from trusted server records rather than client prices or vote quantities.
acceptance: Recheck competition window, active contestant/package, membership and verified-email authorization during payment creation.
Generate a unique reference and persist immutable amountKobo, currency, voteCount and attribution before provider interaction.
Use Paystack test mode and backend-only secrets; validate checkout/callback URLs and return only necessary checkout data.
Define idempotent submission/retry handling for provider timeouts without inconsistent references or duplicate authorization consumption.
Test amount tampering, cross-competition selection, package edits, repeated submission and initialization failure.

issues.title: Authenticate Paystack webhooks and verify payment facts
issues.description: Accept provider signals only after authenticity and transaction checks. A browser redirect cannot prove payment.
acceptance: Preserve the signed webhook payload and verify x-paystack-signature using the documented HMAC-SHA512 scheme and safe comparison.
For supported success events verify server-side provider facts and match status, reference, transaction ID, amount and currency against immutable local records.
Reject/quarantine mismatches and unknown references without votes; separate test/live configuration and keep secrets/personal payloads out of logs.
Acknowledge only after durable processing or durable handoff; verify invalid signatures, wrong amounts/currency, provider failure and transient retry behavior.

issues.title: Allocate paid votes exactly once under concurrent delivery
issues.description: Finalize payments and allocate votes atomically. Existing uniqueness constraints alone do not prove safe counter updates.
acceptance: Commit payment PAID, one allocation and an atomic contestant totalVotes increment in one database transaction using conditional transitions/locking.
Use one idempotent finalizer for webhooks, status refresh and reconciliation; enforce unique payment/provider references.
Match allocation contestant/vote count to the payment snapshot and document policy for confirmation arriving after voting closes.
Run PostgreSQL concurrency and failure-injection tests: duplicate callbacks and status/webhook races produce one allocation/increment, with full rollback on failure.

issues.title: Build checkout return, payment status and voter receipt screens
issues.description: Complete the voter journey using trusted server payment/allocation state.
acceptance: Support hosted checkout, bounded status polling, reload recovery and pending/paid/failed/cancelled retry states.
Show paid only after verified payment and allocation; redirect parameters cannot grant votes.
Protect status/receipt access using a scoped unguessable token or equivalent authorization; avoid email/payment leaks through enumerable IDs.
Verify successful, failed, abandoned, delayed-webhook and return-before-webhook journeys in test mode.

issues.title: Reconcile payments and implement auditable refund/vote-reversal handling
issues.description: Recover from missed events and define refunds/disputes before taking real money. REFUNDED status currently has no reversal ledger.
acceptance: Provide bounded retryable reconciliation using the shared idempotent finalizer for pending/inconsistent payments.
Document late-payment, refund, partial-refund and dispute policy; unsupported cases have a safe documented manual process.
Add immutable uniquely keyed reversal records through a reviewed migration when votes reverse; preserve original allocations and prevent repeated or negative reversals.
Compare counters to allocations less applicable reversals, alert on mismatch and audit repair/refund operations.
Test repeated refunds, missing callbacks and interrupted/retried reconciliation; document provider/dashboard recovery.

issues.title: Implement administrator authentication and protected API access
issues.description: Implement minimal admin security before management endpoints. Pull this prerequisite forward before C01 despite its phase grouping.
acceptance: Document the auth choice: securely hashed AdminUser credentials and one-time bootstrap without default passwords, or an explicit migration to Supabase Auth.
Use expiring revocable sessions and secure cookies; protect cookie-based mutations from CSRF and validate allowed origins.
Apply shared API authorization, inactive-admin checks and login throttling; hiding frontend pages is insufficient.
Test unauthorized access, logout/expiry, inactive users and brute-force limits; redact credentials.

issues.title: Build admin management screens and audit trail
issues.description: Provide a small authenticated interface for operating competitions, contestants and packages.
acceptance: Support login/logout and validated management forms with useful server errors.
Confirm lifecycle/destructive operations and prevent unsafe edits to referenced history.
Persist actor/action/entity and sanitized change details; provide a protected paginated audit view.
Verify each management journey on desktop/mobile and reject direct unauthorized API access.

issues.title: Build admin payment, vote and reconciliation reporting
issues.description: Let the solo operator inspect and resolve discrepancies without manually editing PostgreSQL.
acceptance: Provide paginated filters by competition, state, date and reference; distinguish gross/refunded/net money and vote totals.
Show payment/allocation/reversal history and discrepancies; authorize and audit retry/repair actions.
Restrict voter contact access and exclude secrets; protect CSV against formula injection if exporting.
Verify integer-minor-unit reporting against known paid/failed/refunded fixtures and ledger totals.

issues.title: Establish security and payment-integrity regression tests
issues.description: Establish an isolated integration harness and cross-feature regression suite. Feature-specific acceptance tests belong in each implementation.
acceptance: Apply migrations and deterministic fixtures to isolated PostgreSQL; tests refuse production targets.
Cover verification abuse/replay, authorization, amount/membership tampering, duplicate/out-of-order events, concurrency, rollback and refunds.
Mock provider boundaries deterministically and document a separate sandbox smoke path.
Replace failing placeholder test scripts and prove breaking idempotency or authorization fails the relevant tests.

issues.title: Add pull-request CI checks and migration validation
issues.description: Start CI early and extend it as tests arrive. Root/API test scripts currently fail as placeholders and no workflows exist.
acceptance: Configure GitHub Actions with supported pinned runtime, npm ci, Prisma generation/validation, API typecheck, web lint and production builds.
Apply migrations to disposable PostgreSQL and run implemented tests; PR jobs have no production/provider-live credentials.
Use least-privilege permissions, safe caching and clear failure output.
Demonstrate default-branch and PR runs; document required checks and available branch-protection capabilities.

issues.title: Deploy staging with separated credentials and controlled migrations
issues.description: Deploy the web/API and Supabase PostgreSQL to staging with separate data and Paystack test keys.
acceptance: Choose/document hosts, region and settings with isolated development/staging/production credentials.
Validate runtime pooling versus migration connections, TLS and connection limits; secure exposed Supabase tables via appropriate grants/RLS and server-only privileged keys.
Run prisma migrate deploy in a controlled release step; never migrate dev, reset or demo-seed production.
Configure HTTPS, origins, readiness and webhook URL; pass a complete verification/payment/allocation staging journey.
Document deploy/rollback order and backward-compatible migrations; migration failure blocks release.

issues.title: Prove database recovery and add monitoring/runbooks
issues.description: Establish recoverability and visibility. An applied migration is not proof of reliable backups.
acceptance: Verify actual Supabase plan backup/retention/restore capabilities, define RPO/RTO and time an isolated restore rehearsal.
After restore verify migration state, relations and payment/allocation/reversal consistency; save evidence and operator steps.
Alert on availability/errors, old pending payments, webhook failures, reconciliation mismatches and connection exhaustion.
Document privacy/log retention and recovery for provider outage, key compromise, migration failure and unavailable database.

issues.title: Complete release rehearsal and approve paid-voting launch
issues.description: Use an evidence-based go/no-go gate before real paid traffic.
acceptance: Rehearse mobile/desktop verification, payment success/failure/abandonment, delayed events and admin operations.
Exercise expected peak traffic, duplicate events, closing boundaries and database/provider failures; record acceptable limits.
Review dependency/secret scans, authorization, CORS/CSRF, Supabase exposure and privacy/payment/refund disclosures.
Verify production migration, backups, TLS, live webhook/provider settings and monitoring; complete a controlled live payment/reconciliation check with approved refund handling.
Record owner go/no-go and rollback evidence. Unresolved critical payment/security risks block launch.
